purpose: Independent minimal reproduction of the unmodified upstream fsx startup failure
target: real FUSE mount of the PR branch build
repository: fresh isolated Local repository on the host XFS workspace

fsx.stdout:
Seed set to 1
no extend on truncate! not posix!

sequence: ftruncate to current size, then extend by 100000 bytes
shrink to 4 bytes, re-extend to 100 bytes
read preserved prefix and re-extended range
write across byte 100 and inspect fstat/read before fsync
minimal_probe.note: ftruncate returned success but fstat continued reporting the old size 11; reads through the still-stale open handle returned zero bytes at offsets beyond that size. After the later fsync, path stat reported 101. This points to FUSE-visible size metadata/invalidation or Setattr response handling; it does not establish whether uncommitted staged bytes were lost.

adapter_log_scope: The baseline fuse-adapter.log has only final-close commit/release errors and no per-Setattr trace, so it cannot correlate an individual fsx request.
observation_capture_note: The committed observations.json was emitted by the equivalent inline Python probe used for this run. reproduce.py records the same operation sequence for repeat runs.
